principle: Use current Thailand DOE/HRD Korea Regular Point System Round 18 evidence. Keep Special EPS-TOPIK facts separate.

answers.question: What is the Round 18 Manufacturing target?
What is the total Round 18 target across listed sectors?
answers.writeExactly: Total Round 18 target: 3,300 across Manufacturing, Agriculture/Livestock and Construction.

answers.question: When was Round 18 registration open?
answers.writeExactly: Verified registration window: 2026-07-02 through 2026-07-06. This window is closed.

answers.question: What was the Round 18 application fee?
answers.writeExactly: Official Round 18 application fee: 960 THB through the designated Krungthai Bank payment channel.

answers.question: Can both men and women apply for Manufacturing?
answers.writeExactly: Manufacturing accepts male and female applicants under the verified Round 18 notice.

answers.question: What color-vision condition is stated?
answers.answer: Applicant must not be color blind.

answers.question: What general health condition is stated?
answers.answer: Applicant must be physically fit and not have a disease that obstructs work or a communicable disease prohibited by Korean authorities.
answers.writeExactly: Use the current official health rule and wait for a current provider/checklist notice before medical payment.

answers.question: What legal/travel conditions are stated?
answers.answer: Good conduct, no disqualifying criminal history, not barred from leaving Thailand, no Korea deportation/refusal/illegal-law history, and no drug-related history.
answers.writeExactly: Check all verified legal/travel conditions before proceeding.

answers.question: What prior Korea stay limit applies?
answers.answer: Total prior E-9/E-10 stay must be under 5 years.
answers.writeExactly: Prior E-9/E-10 stay must total less than 5 years.

answers.question: Can an applicant submit more than one electronic application?
answers.writeExactly: Submit only one official electronic application.

answers.question: When did DOE say the Korean-test eligible list would be announced?
answers.writeExactly: DOE announced 2026-08-10 as the Korean-test eligible-list publication date.

answers.question: When did DOE say the skills-test eligible list would be announced?
answers.writeExactly: DOE announced 2026-10-19 as the skills-test eligible-list publication date. Do not pre-promote a result before the official notice.

answers.question: Does passing the tests guarantee selection by a Korean employer?
answers.writeExactly: Passing/roster approval does not guarantee Korean employer selection.

answers.question: What happens if no employer selects the candidate within the first roster year?
answers.answer: The verified notice says the candidate can request extension into year 2 without retaking the Korean-language test.
answers.writeExactly: If no employer selects you during roster year 1, follow the official procedure to request year-2 extension; do not pay a broker for priority.
